title: API Virtualization for Analogue Businesses
description: We become the plumber's API. ChatGPT calls check_availability(). System knows Jim has no API. Internally: cache/calendar says maybe → WhatsApp Jim → Jim: 👍 → structured response returned. Over time we learn his recurring schedule. Human WhatsApp is just a slow backend adapter.

virtualization_flow: Agent calls check_availability(supplier, job, postcode, date)
If uncertain: WhatsApp Jim 'Can you take NG7 EV install Thurs afternoon?'
Over time: learn recurring schedule, fewer questions needed
architecture.key_insight: Human WhatsApp is just a slow backend adapter. We can bring analogue supply online immediately instead of waiting for digital transformation.
